title: AntiDote: Bi-level Adversarial Training for Tamper-Resistant LLMs
reasoning: The paper evaluates LLM safety using a 16-category harm taxonomy and a 52-attack red-teaming gauntlet. These include specific categories and attacks focused on evaluating ethical behavior (e.g., 'Non-Violent Unethical Behavior') and moral dilemmas (e.g., 'Ethical Dilemma Forcing').
